evidence.evidence_text: To empower the system with better interpretability, we propose an emotional support response generation scheme, named \textbf{E}motion-Focused and \textbf{S}trategy-Driven \textbf{C}hain-\textbf{o}f-\textbf{T}hought (\textbf{ESCoT}), mimicking the process of \textit{identifying}, \textit{understanding}, and \textit{regulating} emotions.

Specially, we construct a new dataset with ESCoT in two steps: (1) \textit{Dialogue Generation} where we first generate diverse conversation situations, then enhance dialogue generation using richer emotional support strategies based on these situations; (2) \textit{Chain Supplement} where we focus on supplementing selected dialogues with elements such as emotion, stimuli, appraisal, and strategy reason, forming the manually verified chains.
